items.title: HERE Technologies and AWS: Accelerating NDS.Live with agentic AI
items.summary: HERE Technologies is accelerating NDS.Live map data development with an orchestrated, multi-agent approach built on Kiro. Kiro powers, the Kiro CLI, a three-layer memory system, and Code Intelligence turned a fragile, manual workflow into a consistent, largely automated process with ASPICE traceability captured as work is created.
items.creator: Aleksandar Matic
